# gnosis-architecture

Goals, decisions, and operational contracts for the gnosis knowledge CLI

* [Knowledge and metadata contracts](formats.md) - OKF defines concepts while package-local policies and commit-pinned Gnosis metadata define management.

* [Git synchronization and proposals](git-workflows.md) - Native subtrees and three-way source patches preserve Git semantics without publishing consumer content.

* [Ownership, review, and agent boundaries](ownership.md) - Source-side GitHub rules enforce approvals; meta skills guide agents but do not grant publishing authority.

* [Goals and confirmed requirements](requirements.md) - Separate agent-authored knowledge from CLI-managed structure, with one authoritative source and owner per package.

* [Tooling choices and research record](tooling.md) - Prefer established format, Git, schema, CLI, and agent tooling over custom infrastructure.
